idle.note: The school drifts slowly beneath the water and the ripple breathes without a fast or neon pulse.

bite.note: The larger ring response is readable from the gameplay camera while remaining local to the fishing patch.

catch.note: One authored mirrorperch rises toward the reward socket, clears the dock edge and creel, then hides after the inventory commit.

defectsFoundAndFixed: The first water material was opaque and hid all three fish; it was replaced with a real alpha-blended pond material.
The first proof packet displayed grid lines in every camera; the grid is now isolated to the scale proof.
The far current edge was too pale and marker-like; its alpha and color were reduced to blend into the live pond.
